# Casberi

> Everything you do is scattered across apps, agents, wallets. Casberi is an inbox for your apps and, soon, a rewards account for your subscriptions. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with no account, and read on your device.

Key facts:

- Free on the App Store for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- More than 100 apps connect, among them Gmail, iCloud Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Photos, Apple Health, Apple Wallet, GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira, Notion, Slack, Trello, Stripe, Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, App Store Connect, Readwise, RSS, Substack, YouTube, Spotify, Bluesky, Farcaster, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, Telegram, Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini.
- Every app sits in one of nine categories, each one inbox: Wallet, Markets, Testnets, Work, Day, Life, Agents, Media and Social. See a category all together, or pick one app to see it alone.
- Wallet: one balance across self-custody accounts (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, World Chain, HyperEVM, Robinhood Chain, Tempo, Solana, Bitcoin and Lightning), Coinbase, Kraken, Binance and Gemini, ETH validators, and Wise and Apple Wallet cash. One timeline of card spends, transfers, deposits and swaps. Permissions, positions and risk show what could hurt you; Coming up lists Safe signatures and charges ahead. Railgun, Privacy Pools and Peer sit beside everything else. Watching is read-only: you paste an address or a name, never a seed phrase, and Casberi cannot move your funds.
- Move: an account of your own (a Safe on Base, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain, no seed phrase) and five verbs, each approved with Face ID: Buy a gift card, Receive, Send, Swap and Sweep. Swaps go straight to Uniswap and Aerodrome from the phone, through Tor; a swap to another network crosses through Across. Sweep turns every token under $1 or $5 on a network into ETH in one transaction. Sends, swaps and gift cards can round up, the change buying a token you pick.
- Markets: follow the stock or token behind every app you use, with price alerts.
- Testnets: the Logos testnet, with test coins only, and the Aztec testnet and its sequencers.
- Agents: read what every agent you use did, in one place. Ask Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others with your own key, kept in the Keychain and sent from the device straight to that provider, or Apple Intelligence with no key.
- Notes and voice notes, an address book of everyone across your accounts, and share cards.
- No account, no analytics, no trackers. iCloud sync is opt-in. Export, import and delete-everything are real controls.
- Next, not yet live: pay for your stack from one place, invest in the apps you use, and earn rewards back.
